title: Fall time calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time to fall using t = √(2h/g) or equivalent kinematic equation.

title: Impact speed calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the final speed using v = gt or v = √(2gh).

title: Last-second displacement
description: Important: Correctly finds the displacement during the last second by subtracting the distance fallen in (t-1) seconds from the total height.

title: Average speed in last second
description: Essential: Correctly computes the average speed as the last-second displacement divided by 1 second.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important: Uses consistent units (e.g., meters, seconds, m/s) and converts mass correctly if needed.

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration due to gravity in kinematic equations.

title: Misinterpreting last second
description: Pitfall: Attempts to calculate average speed in the last second using (initial+final)/2 without correct displacement.
